import seaborn as sns

    df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

    exit()

    x="Stress Level",
    y="Quality of Sleep",
    hue="BMI Category",
    size="Sleep Duration",
    col="Sleep Disorder",
    kind="scatter",
    palette="magma_r",

    aspect=1.1,

    data=df,
    x="Stress Level",
    y="Quality of Sleep",
    hue="BMI Category",
    size="Sleep Duration",
    col="Sleep Disorder",
    kind="scatter",
    palette="magma_r",
    sizes=(30, 200),
    alpha=0.7,
    height=5,
    aspect=1.1,
